about:
Everlast Energy & Roofing was founded in 2022 in Manchester, Connecticut by stepbrothers Josh Jackson and Alex Ciccio. The pair, both Connecticut natives, started the business from a small basement with a mission to bring honesty and reliability to homeowners facing unreliable contractors and rising energy costs.

The company provides residential and commercial roofing services including roof replacements, repairs, storm damage restoration, and ventilation solutions, alongside solar energy installations, battery storage, EV charger setup, and solar removal/reinstallation. Operating with a team of over 40 professionals, Everlast has completed more than 800 projects and served over 1,200 homeowners across Connecticut.

Everlast serves residential homeowners and commercial property owners throughout Connecticut. Its customer base includes families seeking roof replacements or solar systems to lower energy bills, as well as businesses needing flat-roof systems such as TPO and rubber roofing. The company also partners with the University of Connecticut as the sole solar partner and a vetted roofing provider.

The founders started Everlast after seeing families struggle with untrustworthy contractors and confusion around energy options. The company emphasizes transparent pricing, clear communication, and a 25-year transferable workmanship warranty on roof replacements, aiming to deliver long-term value and peace of mind.
